10 were healed. Only 1 came back. 🙏

Ten lepers cry out to Jesus from a distance. He sends them to the priests, and they're healed on the way. Only one turns back, falls at His feet and gives thanks, and he's a Samaritan. Jesus asks: “Were there not ten cleansed? but where are the nine?”

Thanksgiving is coming. What are you thanking God for today? 👇

Thanksgiving is in 2 weeks. Start the gratitude now. 🍂

Write 3 thank-yous before your phone. Thank Him for today. Say it out loud to your small group. Thank Him in the hard weeks too. Remember what He said. “In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.”

Which habit are you starting today? Comment 1 to 5 👇
